hypotheses.justification: This can be deleted: from `hsection`, each vertical section of `s \ G` is `ν`-null, and any measurable set `t` witnessing the null-measurable representation of `s \ G` has sections contained in those null sections. Apply Mathlib's `Measure.measure_prod_null_of_ae_null`, which only requires measurability of `t` and does not require `[SFinite ν]`, then transfer the result back using the almost-everywhere equality from `hbad`. Thus the conclusion also holds in the degenerate cases without s-finiteness.
